method: Individual contextual review of all 12 pending patterns on pages 27–33. Preserve source quotations, distinguish inference from allegation and replace generic exercises with three transferable teaching contexts per pattern.
chunks: trying to figure out
正在努力弄明白；设法解决
Describe an ongoing attempt to understand or solve something.
Subject + be + trying to figure out + noun or embedded question; figure it out, not figure out it.
Figure out college means learn how to navigate college life, not calculate a numerical answer.
你新买的洗衣机有很多按钮，向家人解释自己正在研究操作。
settings
washing machine
I'm trying to figure out
I'm trying to figure out which setting to use.

route
everyone
We're trying to figure out
We're trying to figure out which route works for everyone.

你向同事说明报表异常尚未解决，正在查找原因。
numbers
different
I'm trying to figure out
I'm trying to figure out why the numbers are different.

I'm assuming ...
我暂且认为；我推测……
State an assumption openly so others can confirm or correct it.
I'm assuming + clause; optionally follow with is that right? Do not present an assumption as verified knowledge.
The narrator assumes an ID check; source does not establish that it occurred.
家人没有更改晚餐时间，你先说明自己仍按七点来安排。
dinner
seven
I'm assuming

tickets
booked

任务说明没提预算变化，你向经理明确说出当前采用的前提。
budget
unchanged
I'm assuming
I'm assuming the budget is unchanged. Please confirm before I proceed.

By this point
到这个时候；截至这一步
Locate an accumulated result at a particular stage of a narrative.
By this point, + clause; often had + past participle when looking back within a past narrative.
Source introduces an approximate self-reported drink count; the phrase does not verify the count.
你向家人回忆搬家过程，说明到下午时已经打包完大部分物品。
packed
boxes
By this point,
By this point, we had packed most of the boxes.

你向朋友讲徒步经历，说明走到山脚时大家已经很累了。
tired
walking
By this point,
By this point, everyone was tired from walking.

你复盘项目进度，说明进入发布阶段前测试已全部完成。
tests
completed

it would appear
看来似乎……
Offer a cautious conclusion from available information.
It would appear that + clause; would softens the inference and need not refer to a hypothetical future.
At least from the filing limits the source's conclusion; a filed account is not automatically a verified finding.
你查看门口纸条，谨慎告诉家人今天的营业时间可能改了。
hours
changed
It would appear
It would appear that the opening hours have changed.

bus
delayed
It would appear
It would appear that her bus has been delayed.

connection
failed
It would appear

According to the lawsuit
根据诉状所述
Attribute a claim to a legal filing rather than assert it as a proven fact.
According to + identified source, + clause. Transfer to a report, instructions or schedule in ordinary contexts.
Lawsuit attribution matters in the source. Teaching scenarios below are hypothetical readings of documents, not claims about the real case.
你在阅读一个虚构的消费纠纷案例，向家人转述诉状声称的情况。
lawsuit
refund
According to the lawsuit,

schedule
noon

report
costs
According to the report,

it appears that
看来；似乎……
Report an apparent situation while keeping uncertainty visible.
It appears that + full clause; do not omit the subject inside the clause.
Source says appears rather than independently confirming a person's return.
你检查冰箱后发现牛奶没有了，向家人说明目前看到的情况。
milk
run out
It appears that
It appears that we've run out of milk.

road
closed
It appears that

It's unclear how ...
尚不清楚如何……或有多……
Identify an unanswered question about method, cause or degree.
It's unclear how + subject + verb; how long/much/many adds a specific dimension. Use statement order, not question inversion.
Source uses how long for uncertain duration; broader method examples are labeled teaching adaptations.
家里的水渍来源还没有找到，你说明目前不清楚水是怎么进来的。
water
got in
It's unclear how

many

It's unclear how long
尚不清楚要多久或持续了多久
State uncertainty about duration.
It's unclear how long + clause; keep ordinary statement word order after how long.
Source contrasts a reported three-to-five-minute estimate with uncertain actual duration; do not invent a precise time.
维修人员还没给出时间，你向家人说明停水会持续多久还不知道。
water
off
It's unclear how long

wait
queue
It's unclear how long

as alleged in the lawsuit
如诉状所指称的那样
Mark a description as an allegation contained in a filing.
As alleged in + document, + clause. For non-legal reporting use as described/reported in, not alleged for neutral facts.
Alleged is not proven. Source anchors a disputed account to a filing; the phrase itself does not authenticate the account.
在虚构的邻里纠纷阅读练习中，你说明某项说法仅来自诉状。
lawsuit
fence
As alleged in the lawsuit,
As alleged in the lawsuit in this exercise, the fence crossed the boundary.
如本练习的诉状所指称的那样，围栏越过了边界。
朋友讨论一个虚构的新闻案例，你提醒他赔偿要求来自未证实的指控。
claim

It seems like ...
看起来似乎……
Describe an impression or apparent explanation.
It seems like + clause or noun phrase. The source says it seems + clause without like; this heading is a pedagogical adaptation.
Source attribution nests a lawsuit account and Jane's report of what others said; it does not establish the substance's identity independently.

在某个时候；到了某个阶段

At some point + clause; add in/during + period when known. Not the same as by this point.

The lawsuit says
诉状称；诉状中写道
Identify the document that makes a claim.
The lawsuit says + clause; for more precise formal writing, the complaint alleges. Transfer source + says to ordinary documents.
Says personifies the document; a party's filing is not a court finding. Graphic source material remains separate from neutral practice.
